description: Re-fetch a paid report you already bought, by its request_id, within the cache TTL. Free; no payment; the same signed report (request_id re-attached, unsigned, as on the paid result). Over the hosted endpoint GET /v1/citation-report/receipts/<request_id> serves the same bytes; over a local stdio run only that process can. Not found after the TTL, for previews, or for reports served by another process.

request_id.description: The request_id from a paid citation_report / citation_report_large result.

name: citation_report_receipt
title: Citation Integrity Report (receipt re-fetch, free)
